lastRequest: Build a modern AI-powered Personal Study Assistant that helps students study smarter. It should allow users to upload PDFs, DOCX, PPTs, images, and handwritten notes, chat with uploaded study materials, summarize chapters, explain concepts at different difficulty levels, generate quizzes and flashcards, create personalized study plans, track progress, solve doubts with AI, generate mock tests, analyze diagrams, provide interview preparation, support voice input and text-to-speech, maintain study history, and offer a beautiful responsive dashboard with dark/light mode. Use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, JWT authentication, vector search for document retrieval, AI provider abstraction (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Anthropic), Docker, REST API, testing, documentation, and a production-ready architecture.

tasks.title: Project Setup and Database Schema
tasks.description: Initialize monorepo structure, TypeScript configs, Tailwind CSS, Express server with PostgreSQL connection, and complete database migrations for users, study materials, flashcards, and quizzes.

tasks.title: Backend API and AI Integration Core
tasks.description: Implement JWT authentication, repository pattern for data access, and secure service layers integrating LLM APIs for automated flashcard generation, quiz creation, and study summary synthesis.

tasks.title: Frontend Core Architecture and Dashboard
tasks.description: Build React Vite application with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, state management, routing, layout shell, authentication flows, and interactive user dashboard for managing study materials.

tasks.title: Interactive Study Tools Frontend
tasks.description: Develop fully responsive frontend views for interactive flashcard practice sessions, AI-generated quiz execution with instant scoring, and AI chat assistant interface.

tasks.title: System Validation and Production Hardening
tasks.description: Perform end-to-end integration testing, security auditing (CORS, rate-limiting, input sanitization), performance optimization, and containerized deployment configuration.
